mapper.select: SELECT p.bsn_part_id,p.bsn_part_nm FROM mst.bsn_part p WHERE p.hq_yn='N' ORDER BY p.sort_seq,p.bsn_part_id
SELECT p.bsn_part_id,p.bsn_part_nm FROM mst.bsn_part p WHERE p.bsn_part_id=#{id} AND p.hq_yn='N'
SELECT p.bsn_part_id FROM mst.bsn_part p WHERE p.bsn_part_id=#{id} AND p.hq_yn='N' FOR UPDATE
SELECT c.cls_stts_cd FROM fin.mth_cls c WHERE c.cls_ym=#{month}
SELECT FROM fin.part_stlm s WHERE s.bsn_part_id=#{partId} AND s.stlm_ym=#{month}
SELECT FROM fin.part_stlm s WHERE s.bsn_part_id=#{partId} AND s.stlm_ym=#{month} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fin.part_stlm(bsn_part_id,stlm_ym) VALUES(#{partId},#{month}) ON CONFLICT (bsn_part_id,stlm_ym) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT FROM mst.bsn_part_std_hist h WHERE h.bsn_part_id=#{partId} AND h.aply_bgn_ym <=#{month} AND (h.aply_end_ym IS NULL OR h.aply_end_ym >=#{month}) ORDER BY h.aply_bgn_ym DESC,h.part_std_hist_id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM mst.bsn_part_std_hist h WHERE h.bsn_part_id=#{id} ORDER BY h.aply_bgn_ym DESC,h.part_std_hist_id DESC

SELECT s.dev_id,d.dev_nm,s.emp_se_cd,s.duty_se_cd,s.slry_amt,s.rtrpay_acml_amt, (SELECT min(a.bgn_dt) FROM asgn.asgn a WHERE a.dev_id=s.dev_id AND a.asgn_stts_cd!='CANCELLED' AND a.bgn_dt < to_date(#{month},'YYYY-MM')+interval '1 month') AS first_start, (SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT p.prj_nm,', ' ORDER BY p.prj_nm) FROM asgn.asgn a JOIN prj.prj p ON p.prj_id=a.prj_id WHERE a.dev_id=s.dev_id AND a.asgn_stts_cd!='CANCELLED' AND a.bgn_dt < to_date(#{month},'YYYY-MM')+interval '1 month' AND a.end_dt >=to_date(#{month},'YYYY-MM')) AS projects FROM cst.mth_cst s JOIN mst.dev d ON d.dev_id=s.dev_id WHERE s.cst_ym=#{month} AND s.bsn_part_id=#{partId} AND s.duty_se_cd='DIRECT' ORDER BY s.dev_id

SELECT count(DISTINCT a.dev_id) FROM asgn.asgn a WHERE a.asgn_stts_cd!='CANCELLED' AND a.bgn_dt < to_date(#{month},'YYYY-MM')+interval '1 month' AND a.end_dt >=to_date(#{month},'YYYY-MM') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cst.mth_cst s WHERE s.dev_id=a.dev_id AND s.cst_ym=#{month})

SELECT t.dev_id,d.dev_nm,t.emp_se_cd,NULL::text AS projects,t.mm_qty,t.mth_untprc_amt,t.slry_amt, t.bsn_fee_amt,t.rtrpay_amt,t.tot_exp_amt,t.diff_amt,t.prft_amt,t.rmrk_desc FROM fin.part_stlm_dtl t JOIN mst.dev d ON d.dev_id=t.dev_id WHERE t.stlm_id=#{id} ORDER BY t.dev_id
SELECT h.stlm_hist_id,h.stlm_prcs_cd,h.rsn_desc,h.prcs_user_id,h.prcs_at FROM fin.part_stlm_hist h WHERE h.stlm_id=#{id} ORDER BY h.prcs_at DESC,h.stlm_hist_id DESC

SELECT h.rsn_desc FROM sys.data_chg_hist h WHERE h.tbl_nm='fin.part_stlm' AND h.obj_rec_id=CAST(#{id} AS text) AND h.clmn_nm='corp_card_amt' AND h.data_chg_ty_cd='UPDATE' ORDER BY h.chg_at DESC,h.data_chg_hist_id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE fin.part_stlm SET corp_card_amt=#{amount},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,updated_by=#{actor} WHERE stlm_id=#{id} AND stlm_stts_cd='DRAFT'

UPDATE fin.part_stlm SET part_std_hist_id=#{header.part_std_hist_id},prft_dstrb_rt=#{header.prft_dstrb_rt}, bsn_fee_amt=#{header.bsn_fee_amt},psn_cnt=#{header.psn_cnt},tot_sls_amt=#{header.tot_sls_amt}, tot_exp_amt=#{header.tot_exp_amt},tot_diff_amt=#{header.tot_diff_amt},tot_psn_prft_amt=#{header.tot_psn_prft_amt}, part_prft_amt=#{header.part_prft_amt},stlm_stts_cd='CONFIRM',cnfrm_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, cnfrm_user_id=#{actor},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,updated_by=#{actor} WHERE stlm_id=#{header.stlm_id} AND bsn_part_id=#{header.bsn_part_id} AND stlm_ym=#{header.stlm_ym} AND stlm_stts_cd='DRAFT'
